sanskrit_verse:
भूर् धारयति सत्येन सत्येनोदेति भास्करः
सत्येन वायुः पवते सत्येनापः स्रवन्ति च
transliteration:
bhūr dhārayati satyena satyenodeti bhāskaraḥ
satyena vāyuḥ pavate satyenāpaḥ sravanti ca
sph_interpretive_translation:
The Earth sustains by Truth; the Sun rises by Truth;
The Wind blows by Truth; waters flow by Truth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Satya (Absolute Truth)
Causation is rooted in ontological integrity, not material force
Capacity-based responsibility arises from conscious participation in Satya
Restoration logic operates through re-alignment with foundational Truth
Consciousness alignment determines lawful existence and function
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity participates in governance, THEN its capacity must be verified against Satya-based alignment
IF a natural process falters, THEN trace causal deviation from foundational Satya-resonance
IF a dispute arises, THEN resolution shall proceed via re-establishment of truthful resonance
IF institutional function decays, THEN recalibrate based on Satya-sustained capacity metrics
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, all rulings must originate from Satya as the foundational pramāṇa. Legal validity is contingent upon alignment with the sustaining truth of existence. Institutions derive authority only insofar as they resonate with this immutable principle.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is Satya itself—observable, sustaining, and self-evident. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential misalignment leading to dysfunction. Responsibility is proportional to conscious deviation from sustaining truth. Justice restores resonance rather than imposing suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Satya-resonance audit for all involved parties
Deploy consciousness-realignment modules grounded in Vedic vibratory alignment
Establish completion process for reintegration into Satya-sustained societal flow
Activate dharma-field recalibration through yajña-based vibrational correction
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is declared: Truth sustains all existence. Law is alignment. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
